claim: A folder-open task declares a Node entry under a hidden path with an atypical filename suffix.
scope: Trigger and command must occur in the same parsed task object.
limits: Configuration-only evidence; no target script body was supplied or executed.
The rule asserts a likely hostile launch pattern, not credential theft or other payload behavior.
Matchers cover plain single-file Node commands in task objects with up to 32 keys; quoted paths, inline eval and complex shell wrappers need their existing separate detectors.
